patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,33 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    result = []
+    
+    for i in range(take):
+        current_bottles = start - i
+        
+        # First line of verse
+        if current_bottles == 0:
+            line1 = "No more bottles of beer on the wall, no more bottles of beer."
+        elif current_bottles == 1:
+            line1 = "1 bottle of beer on the wall, 1 bottle of beer."
+        else:
+            line1 = f"{current_bottles} bottles of beer on the wall, {current_bottles} bottles of beer."
+        
+        # Second line of verse
+        next_bottles = current_bottles - 1
+        if current_bottles == 0:
+            line2 = "Go to the store and buy some more, 99 bottles of beer on the wall."
+        elif next_bottles == 0:
+            line2 = "Take it down and pass it around, no more bottles of beer on the wall."
+        elif next_bottles == 1:
+            line2 = "Take one down and pass it around, 1 bottle of beer on the wall."
+        else:
+            line2 = f"Take one down and pass it around, {next_bottles} bottles of beer on the wall."
+        
+        result.append(line1)
+        result.append(line2)
+        
+        # Add empty line between verses (except after the last verse)
+        if i < take - 1:
+            result.append("")
+    
+    return result
